Guild Charter

 

We are the Chiaroscuro. Formed from the earthen realm, the Chiaroscuro, properly pronounced *chiar-oscu-ro*, has many meanings and definitions. Truly, it is the merging together of the light and darkness. It is the shadows and the light. Which in some eyes..would mean neutral. And that is what we are. Bonded together we hold the strong belief that all Norrathians were placed in the realm to be strong of heart and mentality. No one is perfect, we realize this, however we strive to be the ones who are fair and respectful, to promote helping of each other and a unification of races and alignments to allow Norrath freed from the wraith of those who would seek to destroy us and all we have worked for.

In time, we will scribe our history, we have much to say and do in this world. Let this guild be one that makes a difference. In closing, if you feel you can actively contribute to the Chiaroscuro then we would be honoured to have you. Please visit our area regarding membership requirements and then consider from there. Good travels and Darkest of eves to you...
